stemMd: A storage company charges a one-time setup fee of 18 dollars and 7 dollars per week. A customer pays 81 dollars in total. For how many weeks is the unit rented?
explanationMd: Subtract the one-time fee: 81−18=63 dollars pays for weeks. Divide by 7 dollars per week to obtain 9 weeks. Check: 18+7(9)=81.

distractorRationale.d: This is the rental charge after removing setup, not the number of weeks.
distractorRationale.a: This uses the weekly rate as the number of weeks.
distractorRationale.c: This does not correctly subtract the setup fee before division.
